working_definition: "C15(+) adPNs": anterodorsal-lineage antennal-lobe olfactory projection neurons (46 cells) within Davie et al. 2018 res-2.0 cluster 27, expressing the homeodomain transcription factor C15, reproducing a Li et al. (2017) SMART-seq2 subcluster. Uniglomerular, projecting via iACT to mushroom body calyx and lateral horn. The report explicitly flags that C15 is a combinatorial transcriptomic marker of uncertain anatomical specificity - not established as marking one single named glomerular PN type.
searches_performed: adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN

best_match.fbbt_term: adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN
best_match.fbbt_definition: An adult antennal lobe projection neuron that is derived from neuroblast ALad1 (FBbt:00067346). All of these neurons have axons that fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract (mALT) and innervate the lateral horn.

justification: FBbt has no term built on the C15 marker or citing Li et al. 2017 / Davie et al. 2018 for this specific subgroup (searched directly - no hits). The report itself concludes this is a transcriptomic subgroup of the adPN lineage of uncertain correspondence to a specific glomerular PN type; only 6 of the many PN classes Li et al. (2017) profiled were 'unequivocally mapped' to a known glomerulus, and whether C15(+) adPNs is one of these is not established. The cluster IS-A adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN (FBbt:00007438) but carries a distinguishing marker (C15) that FBbt does not capture at any level, so this is an honest broad match rather than an exact one.
recommendation: Broad-match to the adPN lineage term. Per dataset guidance, do not mint a new term for this marker subgroup since the report cannot confirm it corresponds to a single reproducible glomerular type (rather than a boundary/mixed transcriptomic group); both flags left false.
